title: Project A119 to set off a nuclear blast on the Moon
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Project A119 to set off a nuclear blast on the Moon, about unspecified at Kirtland Air Force Base, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: know he was a secret consultant on a project called a119 a top secret Air Force Project based out of Kirtland Air Force Base
was involved in this 1958 project called A119 where we were going to nuke the moon as a show of force against the Soviets.
tellings.difference: Dates it to 1958 and gives the motive as a show of force against the Soviets, but leaves out Kirtland AFB.
tellings.link_reason: Both are the Project A119 plan to set off a nuclear blast on the Moon, with Sagan involved.
